acquisition_method: MS data was acquired using a data-dependent top20 method dynamically choosing the most abundant precursor ions from the survey scan (350–1800 m/z) for HCD fragmentation.
alkylation_reagent: alkylated with iodoacetamide (200 mM IAA/100 mM NH 4 HCO 3 ) in the dark at room temperature for 30 min.
alkylation_concentration: alkylated with iodoacetamide (200 mM IAA/100 mM NH 4 HCO 3 ) in the dark at room temperature for 30 min.
cleavage_agent: Gel pieces were digested overnight in 12.5 ng/μl trypsin in 25 mM NH 4 HCO 3 .
collision_energy: Normalized collision energy was 27 and the isolation window was set to 1.5 Th.
enrichment_method: the endostyle protein was incubated with the antibody specific to B. taurus TG protein overnight at 4 °C with shaking, to facilitate the formation of the antigen-antibody complex.
fractionation_method: Gel pieces were cut from SDS-PAGE, destained for 20 min in 100 mM NH 4 HCO 3 with 30% Acetonitrile and washed with Milli-Q water until the gels were destained.
fragmentation_method: MS data was acquired using a data-dependent top20 method dynamically choosing the most abundant precursor ions from the survey scan (350–1800 m/z) for HCD fragmentation.
instrument: MS experiments were performed on a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer that was coupled to Easy nLC (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: inferred: "MS data were analyzed using MaxQuant software version 1.5.8.3." No labeling strategy (TMT, iTRAQ, SILAC, dimethyl, ICAT) is mentioned in the text.
reduction_reagent: The in-gel proteins were reduced with dithiothreitol (10 mM DTT/ 100 mM NH 4 HCO 3 ) for 30 min at 56 °C.
reduction_concentration: The in-gel proteins were reduced with dithiothreitol (10 mM DTT/ 100 mM NH 4 HCO 3 ) for 30 min at 56 °C.
